description: A FastAPI router module defining an endpoint '/summary' that returns a stubbed financial summary report for authenticated users. It imports dependencies, security, and report schema, and defines a single asynchronous GET endpoint returning a summary report with fixed inflow and outflow values.

classes.name: SummaryReport
classes.description: Schema representing the financial summary report with total inflow, total outflow, and net values.

methods.name: SummaryReport summary_report(_: TokenData = Depends(require_role("user")))
methods.description: Asynchronous endpoint handler returning a stubbed summary report for the authenticated user.
